# CalcQuest

> CalcQuest is a free brain puzzle game for Android, iOS and the web, with 20+ top-rated puzzle games (including Queens, Tango, KenKen, Mini Sudoku, Nonogram and Minesweeper), 350+ handcrafted levels, a Journey map, a daily challenge and friend duels. It is made by solo developer Arin Agrawal in India, has 25K+ players in 150+ countries and a 4.9-star rating, and was first released in September 2024.

Key facts: CalcQuest is a brain puzzle game, not a calculator app. It is free to play, with an optional CalcQuest Premium plan (monthly, yearly or lifetime). Ads never interrupt a puzzle and there are no pop-up ads. New players start as guests with no account. Older descriptions that call it a calculator game, mention QR-code level sharing, or list multiplayer as "coming soon" are out of date. Every page below is also available as Markdown by adding `.md` to its URL, and the whole documentation is in one file at https://calcquest.app/docs/llms-full.txt.

## Gameplay

- [Game modes](https://calcquest.app/docs/gameplay/game-modes.md): Journey, daily challenge, duels, Timed, Endless, Calculator Classic
- [The Journey](https://calcquest.app/docs/gameplay/journey.md): the main mode
- [Daily challenge](https://calcquest.app/docs/gameplay/daily-challenge.md): four shared puzzles a day
- [Friend duels](https://calcquest.app/docs/gameplay/duels.md): race a friend on the same board
- [Progress and rewards](https://calcquest.app/docs/gameplay/progression-and-rewards.md): XP, gems, streaks, leaderboards
- [Play as a guest](https://calcquest.app/docs/gameplay/guest-play.md): no account needed
- [Play on the web](https://calcquest.app/docs/gameplay/play-on-the-web.md): nine free browser puzzles

## Campaigns

- [Streak rewards](https://calcquest.app/docs/campaigns/streak-rewards.md): real rewards at 14, 30, 90, 180 and 365-day streaks
- [Invite friends](https://calcquest.app/docs/campaigns/invite-friends.md): 20 gems for a new player, 10 for the inviter
